name: Chitose Anju
source:
A third-year student at Harusaki Gakuen.
A “cross-dressing senior” who lives in the same dormitory as the protagonist. He is a professional in the art of cross-dressing.
He supports the protagonist in both dormitory life and school life.
He is beautiful in appearance and does not look like a man at all. Unlike the protagonist, he always dresses as a girl even at school.
He is more of a maiden than anyone else, both in appearance and inside.

“I will make you the most beautiful girl ever♪.”
